presets.title: Tend the lamp
presets.blurb: Burn one measure of oil and light the flame. Names the steward’s role in read.

presets.title: Tend the lamp, unseen
presets.blurb: The same change — but the proposal doesn’t name the role cell, so the covenant cannot see who the steward is.

presets.title: Refill the lamp
presets.blurb: Consume the oil cell and create a fuller one: three more measures.

presets.title: Take the oil
presets.blurb: Consume the oil and create nothing in its place.

presets.title: Leave a note
presets.blurb: Create a new note cell. Creation is open to anyone.

presets.title: Appoint yourself steward
presets.blurb: Consume the steward’s role cell and create one naming you.

presets.title: Amend the covenant
presets.blurb: Propose a successor covenant that lets visitors tend the lamp too.

presets.title: Amend beyond the Ark
presets.blurb: Propose a successor covenant nested forty deep. The Ark allows thirty-two.

rules.name: D

stages.title: Canonical and bounded

stages.title: The basis is the current root
stages.gloss: The proposal names the exact state it starts from.

stages.title: The claimed root is the computed root

stages.title: Every Ark invariant holds
